sdk: QEMU7/FEMU author build, read-only objects linked to workspace FTLs
guest: Ubuntu focal cloud image, 4 vCPU, 2GiB RAM
read_prewarm: 6 logical-size passes of matching 512KiB write; random-map enabled
write_repeat_state: Fresh independent VM for each repeat; no prewarm
read_repeat_state: Three windows on the unchanged prewarmed VM
notes: NAND delays and exact physical/logical capacities are in per-run method.json. Host memory backend is not mlocked; observed swap is logged per stage.
supplemental_writes: After formal read windows and optional shared-range probe, collect three matching 60s consecutive write windows on each prewarmed device. Separate cohort/figure; do not replace independent fresh-write rows or assume steady state.
supplemental_actual_runtime: Configured60s; FIO drains in-flight requests. Actual runtime and maximum I/O latency are retained per window.
gc_timeline_verification: verify_gc_read_dependencies.py validates full-geometry before/after source snapshots and counters. Extended600s queue timeouts exist only in excluded crash diagnostics.
